# Anonyflow

AnonyFlow offers a simple and powerful service for encryption-based data anonymization and community sharing, enabling GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA data privacy protection compliance.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/anonyflow/.

## Actions

- **Anonymize Value** (read-only): Anonymize a string or array of string values.
- **Deanonymize Packet** (read-only): Deanonymize a json data packet using your private key.
- **Deanonymize Value** (read-only): Deanonymize one or more anonymized string values.
- **Test Connection** (read-only): Test the connection to the anonyflow api.
